# Support

Parallax is an early-stage project. Before asking for help:

1. Read the [README](../README.md),
   [architecture guide](../docs/architecture.md), and
   [security model](../docs/security.md).
2. Search existing GitHub issues.
3. Use the issue chooser to open a bug report, feature request, or usage question.

Include the Parallax version or commit, operating system, Node.js and pnpm
versions, the exact command you ran, expected behavior, actual behavior, and a
minimal reproduction. Remove secrets and personal data from logs.

Do not use GitHub issues for vulnerabilities. Follow the
[security policy](SECURITY.md) to report them privately.
